mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) directly reduces the discount rate applied to equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% (t-test p>0.05 for positive mean).

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL rises above 232.0, it signals inflationary pressure that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 232.0 (t-test p>0.05 for negative mean).

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) combined with declining housing starts (HOUST) signals a deteriorating labor market and weak consumer demand, triggering a sell-off in equities and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when UNRATE>7.5 and HOUST<850.0 (t-test p>0.05 for negative mean).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (characterized by strong growth and high employment), a rise in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) signals the onset of inflationary pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises >0.5% (t-test p>0.05 for negative mean).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 97.0 indicates a contraction in the manufacturing sector, reducing corporate earnings expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when INDPRO < 97.0 (t-test p>0.05 for negative mean).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales (RSAFS) below 410,000.0 indicates weakening consumer spending, which reduces corporate revenue growth expectations and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when RSAFS < 410000.0 (t-test p>0.05 for negative mean).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 8.0% indicates a deteriorating labor market, reducing consumer spending power and corporate hiring, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0 (t-test p>0.05 for negative mean).

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 0.15%), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 97.0) signals an economic slowdown that the Fed's policy is failing to prevent, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS>0.15 and INDPRO<97.0 (t-test p>0.05 for negative mean).
